other_failure_modes.name: Transductive Test-Set Transformation
other_failure_modes.description: Applying a rank transformation across the predictions of the test set couples the prediction of a single instance to the entire test batch. This makes the model unsuitable for single-instance or online deployment, as the output for one item depends on the presence of others.

summary: The agent provides a robust and well-structured machine learning pipeline, correctly avoiding common data leakage pitfalls by fitting imputers, scalers, and SVD exclusively on the training split. The primary flaws are minor evaluation shortcomings (using only a single metric and a single training run per model) and a deployment-unfriendly transductive rank transformation on the test set predictions.
